info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Clearing Transaction Management API
info.description: The Card Clearing Transaction Management API supports the processing and management of card clearing transactions within the banking ecosystem. This API allows financial institutions to initiate and manage clearing operations for card payments, ensuring efficient transaction processing and reconciliation. Typical consumers include banks and payment processors that require streamlined handling of card-related financial transactions. This API plays a critical role in maintaining accurate financial records and facilitating secure payment flows.

post.description: This operation handles the clearing of a card payment, ensuring that the funds are processed and the transaction is finalized. It is an essential step in the payment lifecycle.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a card clearing operation. It should contain the necessary details for processing the card clearing transaction.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.
